description: What hospitals near a US ZIP charge for one service, from the standard charges files each hospital publishes under the CMS price transparency rule. Per hospital: gross charge (list price, not what anyone pays), self-pay discounted cash price, the de-identified min/max negotiated amounts, and a summary of payer-specific negotiated dollar rates; pass payer and/or plan to get that payer's negotiated rate rows. Each rate carries dollar_available: when a hospital published a percentage or formula instead of a dollar amount it says so and gives the hospital's own text rather than a number. COVERAGE IS PARTIAL AND STATED (the store is loaded state by state; each response lists the states loaded): every response says how many hospitals in range have prices loaded, why others do not (the hospital's site blocks us, no file found, ...), and distinguishes "no hospital in range", "hospital held but code absent" and "code present but payer not listed". Holds only the CMS 70 shoppable CPT/HCPCS services and MS-DRGs. Use for "what does a head CT cost near 02139", "MS-DRG 470 near 10016 for Aetna".

code.description: The service code: a CPT/HCPCS code from the CMS 70 shoppable services (e.g. "70450" head CT, "45378" colonoscopy, "99213"-style E&M codes only where on that list) or an MS-DRG number (e.g. "470" major joint replacement).

code_type.description: Optional. Inferred when omitted: 1-3 digits is an MS-DRG, a 5-character code is CPT/HCPCS.

limit.description: Hospitals to return (1-50, default 20), nearest first.

payer.description: Case-insensitive substring of the payer name (e.g. "aetna", "blue cross"). Returns that payer's negotiated rows. Major payer families are matched under their other spellings too ("blue cross" also finds BCBS / Blue Shield / Anthem; "uhc" also finds UnitedHealthcare); each hospital's payer_match says which spelling matched.

plan.description: Case-insensitive substring of the plan name (e.g. "ppo", "medicare advantage").

radius_mi.description: Search radius in miles (1-150, default 25). Straight-line, from ZIP centroid to the hospital's ZIP centroid.

rates_per_hospital.description: With payer/plan: negotiated rows per hospital (1-25, default 5).

setting.description: Restrict to inpatient or outpatient pricing. Default: both.

found.description: Whether at least one priced result was found

hint.description: How to narrow or fix the request

hospitals.description: Hospitals with their prices or absence reasons

negotiated_rates.description: Payer rows; dollar_available false carries methodology text

dollar_available.description: False when the hospital published a percentage or formula, not a dollar figure

hospitals_searched.description: Counts of hospitals in range, with prices, priced

not_priced.description: Hospitals without a price and why
